info.title: OpenBridge minimal model interaction gateway
info.description: Current envelope-level HTTP contract, not complete standard conformance. The independent _openbridge attachment is rejected on protocol envelopes/items and never emitted. Other named OpenBridge reasoning/usage/cache rules remain separately bounded. Current priority is Agent-first Text/Image/File through standard Responses; Chat is a compatibility path. A static single-image GPT Image operation is available through explicit image bindings, with explicit model selection and single-source API-key activation; image operations are not activated by an existing conversation binding. Embeddings, other media operations and audio Realtime remain later work. No models discovery, stateful resources or implicit retry/fallback.

post.summary: Generate text from admitted text or user image input through single-candidate Chat
Generate one inline image using the static GPT Image profile

200.description: One complete inline image after strict upstream EOF. Requires explicit activation. Binary image bindings must be selected in models and have the matching single-source, non-fallback pool.

post.summary: Generate text from explicitly admitted text, image, inline or URL file input through stateless Responses

ProbeId.name: x-openbridge-probe-id
ProbeId.description: Operator correlation only when private probe diagnostics are enabled and authentication succeeds. Valid form: 32 lowercase hex run ID, colon, then decimal 1..999999. Invalid/duplicate values disable observation only, not business admission. Never forwarded upstream or echoed downstream. Not semantic request data.

bearerAuth.description: Exactly one Authorization header. Configured startup secret, not an upstream API key.

ImageGenerationRequest.description: Bounded non-streaming single-image slice. Missing/null options remain distinct. Other image controls, URL output, edits, multiple images and streaming are rejected before I/O. A target may reject controls its endpoint does not declare. Image bindings require explicit model selection; they do not expand default conversation activation.

ImageUsage.description: Unsigned 64-bit reported counts. Total equals input plus output; each supplied modality breakdown sums to its owning count. Unknown usage is not synthesized. For a trusted route using OmitUnrepresentableAccounting, token reports that cannot satisfy this complete standard shape are retained in IR but the entire downstream usage is omitted. Billing has no standard carrier and is omitted only under that policy; strict routes reject it.

b64_json.description: Strict Base64, nonempty decoded bytes, at most 2 MiB decoded. Representation validation does not decode pixels or attest format.

size.description: Reported pixel dimensions, each at most 65536; not inferred from request defaults.

ImageGenerationResponse.description: All optional facts preserve absent/null/value; no URL fetch, file service, revised prompt or private carrier. JSON has the shared 4 MiB hard ceiling and tighter operator/endpoint budgets.

PublicModelLabel.description: Activated public model label without a provider/ prefix. Resolves a fixed trusted Route; canonical identity and Provider-specific upstream model names remain internal. Clients cannot select a Provider.

CacheSession.description: OpenBridge scoped extension: caller-supplied Provider cache/observability grouping, not a gateway-managed session. Only explicitly supporting targets may receive it. No derivation from prompt_cache_key, user, safety_identifier or opaque replay; unsupported targets reject it. OpenCode Go maps an explicit ASCII session_id to x-opencode-session instead of the upstream body; absent values do not create an identity. Incoming session headers are not forwarded.

prompt_cache_key.description: Advisory Provider cache-affinity key. Targets without a declared key carrier omit it; automatic caching is independent. Does not select or reorder OpenBridge candidates.

messages.description: User/assistant and system/developer content accepts a string or nonempty ordered plain-text part array. Tool result content accepts a string or ordered plain-text part array, including an empty array; single tool-result parts remain arrays. User content additionally admits ordered text/image_url parts when public and endpoint contracts permit image input; one image remains an array. HTTP(S) URL and Base64 image data URL only; file IDs, other roles' images, tool-result media remains rejected. Assistant audio history has separate library admission and trusted source/expiry requirements in the Chat media profile; unbound audio IDs and existing text/image-only product bindings reject it.

modalities.description: Library output intent; audio requires matching audio options and explicit public/endpoint audio_output admission. Existing text/image bindings do not gain audio admission.

audio.description: Named-voice output options, not voice/account management. Requires audio modality; streaming requires pcm16. No audio model is activated by this schema.

max_completion_tokens.description: Bootstrap defaults absent/null to 1024 and rejects values above 16384 after semantic decode.

metadata.description: Typed request hint, never copied into reported response metadata.

service_tier.description: Request hint; the reported effective tier may differ. Endpoint context admission remains independent.

logprobs.description: Return token probabilities when true; null/false are inactive controls.

top_logprobs.description: A non-null integer requires logprobs:true; null normalizes to absent.

ChatRequest.description: Additional fields require admission by the Chat text profile and selected public contract; additionalProperties does not authorize arbitrary upstream parameters. Function-only tool_choice.allowed_tools uses the nested Chat shell. Explicit assistant-message/tool-call membership cannot be projected to a standard Responses target; incompatible history is rejected before upstream I/O, without dropping the owner or membership. OpenBridge's Chat extension admits scoped openai-responses-v1 reasoning_details on assistant history; preserve those actual output details for replay rather than treating them as ordinary assistant text.

prompt_cache_key.description: Advisory Provider cache-affinity key, independent of session_id. Cache echoes/usage are only upstream-reported facts.

max_output_tokens.description: Bootstrap defaults absent/null to 1024 and rejects values above 16384 after semantic decode.

ResponsesRequest.description: Detailed input, settings and inactive-state admission follow the Responses profile, including its user input_image URL/inline slice and target-specific optional detail restrictions. User input_file admits exactly one of bounded Base64 data URLs in file_data or HTTP(S) file_url, optional filename (including an explicit empty string) and auto/low/high detail only when public and endpoint contracts explicitly admit file_input. file_url additionally requires the target URL flag, is preserved exactly, forbids userinfo/control/whitespace/backslash characters and never selects Gateway origin/auth. Remote MIME, size, redirects and content stability are unknown to the Gateway. File IDs, raw Base64 without a data URL, file cache breakpoints, tool files and Chat file projection are rejected; no file is opened, fetched, uploaded or parsed. File budgets and target restrictions are independent of images, and this schema does not activate a file model. Function/custom tool-result arrays additionally admit ordered text and URL/inline image parts only when the public/endpoint contracts explicitly admit tool_result_images; user image admission alone is insufficient. User and tool images share target image limits. File IDs, image cache breakpoints, instruction/assistant images and generated media remain rejected; Chat targets reject tool images before I/O. Models with only a Chat startup entry return model_not_found here; no implicit protocol fallback. Each program in replay history requires a matching program_output; missing outputs are rejected before upstream I/O. Library continuation views do not add request fields, infer turn completion or authorize automatic execution. No arbitrary endpoint, credential or header selection. The independent _openbridge attachment is rejected, not ignored. Typed structured arguments/results, execution reports, message-call membership and nonstandard replay remain unrepresentable by the public wire. Ordinary business keys inside permitted metadata or raw arguments/output are not protocol attachments. Precise admission belongs to the client-generation profile.

Generation.description: Current profile-specific JSON response or incremental SSE, retaining the public model label. Typed output, usage and dependencies must be representable by the selected client contract; unrepresentable facts are not silently dropped. No independent _openbridge attachment is emitted. Other named profile differences still prevent a full standard-conformance claim. Exact text, tool, usage, grouping and replay admission belongs to docs/architecture-v2/responses-text-profile.md, chat-text-profile.md and client-generation-profile.md. Chat audio/citations have separate library scope in chat-media-profile.md, not automatic product activation. HTTP 200 does not prove semantic completion, stream closure or output adherence. Late failures abort the body without a fabricated successful terminal.

Error.description: Sanitized application error. 401 includes WWW-Authenticate: Bearer. No upstream body, origin, credential locator or parser input is reflected. HTTP parser failures occur outside this envelope.
